description_en: Retrieves the overall firewall interception trends, including Internet, VPC, and NAT traffic
description_zh: 获取防火墙总拦截趋势，包括互联网/VPC/NAT流量
name: DescribeFirewallDropTrend

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Specifies the start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter is required and must be provided together with EndTime. The value must be a UNIX timestamp in seconds and must be earlier than EndTime. If this parameter is not provided, the API returns ErrorTimeError(400)
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。本参数实际为必填项且需与 EndTime 同时提供，需传秒级 Unix 时间戳且应早于 EndTime；未提供时 API 返回 ErrorTimeError(400)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies the end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter is required and must be provided together with StartTime. The value must be a UNIX timestamp in seconds and must be later than StartTime. If this parameter is not provided, the API returns ErrorTimeError(400)
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。本参数实际为必填项且需与 StartTime 同时提供，需传秒级 Unix 时间戳且应晚于 StartTime；未提供时 API 返回 ErrorTimeError(400)
parameters.name: end_time

InternetDropSession.description_en: The number of sessions blocked by the Internet firewall
InternetDropSession.description_zh: 互联网防火墙拦截会话数

NatDropSession.description_en: The number of sessions blocked by the NAT firewall

Time.description_en:
The time when the traffic occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

If the data at this point in time has not been processed, the values of other fields are -1
Time.description_zh:
流量发生的时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。

若该时间点未加工完成，则其他字段值均为-1

TotalDropSession.description_en: The total number of sessions blocked by the firewall

VpcDropSession.description_en: The number of sessions blocked by the VPC firewall

MaxDropSession.description_en: The maximum number of total blocked sessions

MaxDropTime.description_en: The time when the maximum number of total blocked sessions occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1672502400
MaxDropTime.description_zh: 总拦截会话数最大值发生时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示，如1672502400
